plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 60-Minute End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as required for this case.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared event.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order dialog.
Confirm that the recreate dialog opened.
Set the recreated event's end-time duration to 60 minutes.
Verify that the evaluation duration remains 30 minutes.
Verify that no delayed schedule is selected.
Create the recreated event using the configured duration and evaluation settings.
Verify that the recreated event carries the prepared RFQ quantity.
Verify that the recreated event carries the prepared RFQ unit.
Open the recreated event's participants list to verify the known bidding participants were carried over.
Find Vendor A in the recreated event's participant list.
Verify that Vendor A remains selected on the recreated event.
Find Vendor B in the recreated event's participant list.
Verify that Vendor B remains selected on the recreated event.
